caption: The drawing depicts a large, wood and metal tool positioned diagonally across the page. The tool features a long, cylindrical wooden handle at the top, attached to a rectangular, rust-colored metal segment that forms the main body. At the base of this segment, there is a horizontal wooden piece shaped somewhat like a flattened, oval bar, perpendicular to the handle, forming a T-shape overall. The wooden portions are rendered in shades of brown, showing wood grain, while the metal part is illustrated in mottled shades of dark brown and gray with some signs of wear and oxidation. To the upper right of the tool, there is a small sepia-toned vignette showing a person operating a similar tool, pushing it across the ground. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The drawing is signed "OSCAR A. LIEBER" at the bottom right.
title: Currier's Shaving Knife
